name: Foundgine
description: Foundgine semantic execution layer and MCP adapter for exposing authorized, provider-neutral application capabilities to AI agents.

tools.name: foundgine_capabilities
tools.purpose: Discover the semantic capability contract available to the current caller.

tools.name: foundgine_query
tools.purpose: Execute provider-neutral read intent through the Foundgine planning and execution pipeline.

tools.name: foundgine_query_semantic
tools.purpose: Execute an already-structured, provider-neutral read intent (rootEntity, selections, optional filter/order/pagination) without lexical grounding.

tools.name: foundgine_mutation_dry_run
tools.purpose: Validate and authorize a mutation without executing it.

tools.name: foundgine_mutation_approve
tools.purpose: Create an approval bound to an authorized mutation plan.

tools.name: foundgine_mutation_execute_approved
tools.purpose: Execute an approved mutation after authorization and plan-fingerprint revalidation.

clients.name: @foundgine/typescript
clients.runtime: Node.js 20+ or any runtime with fetch

clientNotes: Clients are thin transport libraries for this MCP endpoint and the Temporal workflow routes under /foundgine/workflows. They carry no authority; the server resolves and authorizes every call.

integrations.name: Foundgine.Providers (Microsoft Agent Framework + Redis)
integrations.status: included in the Foundgine.Providers NuGet package; tests are in the solution

integrations.name: foundgine-providers (LangChain4j + Spring Boot + Redis)
integrations.status: included in the foundgine-providers Maven artifact; framework dependencies are optional
